# Architecture Best Practices for Migration

Sign in

## AWS re:Invent 2025

### CEO Matt Garman shares how AWS is shaping the future of cloud tech

Join AWS CEO Matt Garman to hear how AWS is innovating across every aspect of the world’s leading cloud. He explores how we are reinventing foundational building blocks as well as developing brand new experiences, all to empower customers and partners with what they need to build a better future.

Learn more

### AI agents in action: Architecting the future of applications

Explore how agentic AI is transforming cloud-native application architecture, unlocking faster innovation cycles and entirely new application patterns. Learn how new AWS capabilities empower builders to design secure, reasoning-driven agents that orchestrate data, code, and tools at scale, with an emphasis on governance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Discover how AWS customers are deploying production-ready agents today, and learn best practices to help you architect agentic applications that autonomously adapt, optimize, and act in real-time.

Learn more

### Accelerate your migration & modernization journey with EBA Cloud Party

Migration and modernization often face challenges - including legacy processes, compressed timelines, scalability, silos (data and people), and technical friction points. Overcome these challenges and accelerate your cloud journey with a truly immersive, hands-on, outcome-focused gamified Experience-Based Acceleration (EBA) cloud party. Become an expert on the latest migration and modernization architectures, build end-to-end solutions with GenAI, and gain hands-on expertise on AWS Transform in a cross-functional manner. Become an innovator of scalable patterns and embrace a new cloud-fluent way of working, while having fun! Are you ready for the most anticipated Cloud Party of 2025?

Learn more

### A leaders guide to accelerating large-scale migration

In this session, hear about a simplified and streamlined approach to cloud migration based on real-world experience leading successful all-in migrations to AWS and guiding hundreds of other organizations on their enterprise migration journeys. Get insight that seeks to challenge conventional wisdom, and hear about what’s been proven to work as well as some common pitfalls to avoid. Learn how you can help get employees invested, create forcing functions for innovation, and build accountability, while managing uncertainty and achieving a faster, cheaper, and more efficient migration process. The time to migrate is now.

Learn more
